title: Tensor-Induced Backreaction in Ultra-Slow-Roll Inflation
summary: We discuss the impact of tensor-induced backreaction at second order in perturbation theory on primordial black holes production in single-field inflationary models, where the comoving curvature power spectrum is amplified by a transient ultra-slow-roll phase. Although the leading perturbative correction is mostly negligible in standard slow-roll evolution, it becomes important in non-attractor regimes, going in the direction of limiting the suppression of the first slow-roll parameter $\varepsilon$ and reducing the enhancement of the scalar power spectrum.
